EchtpostAPIKeyCredential.title: Echtpost API Key
EchtpostAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste an EchtPost API key for server-to-server workflow automation. Use a sandbox key while testing; live card creation spends account credit. The key is sent only to api.echtpost.de, in X-Api-Key.

content.description: Card text. Use {anrede} as a per-recipient salutation placeholder (casing ignored). Required when the motive has `content_available: true`; otherwise only blank or omitted text is accepted.
content.title: Content

content_ps.description: Optional P.S., printed as a single footer line. Non-empty values return 422 `not_available_for_motive` when the motive has `content_ps_available: false`.
content_ps.title: Content Ps

content_vertical.description: Optional vertical text. Non-empty values return 422 `not_available_for_motive` when the motive has `vertical_text_available: false`. A custom value requires the booked vertical text upgrade for the account, otherwise 422 `feature-not-available`. Your account's own stored vertical text and the EchtPost default are always accepted.
content_vertical.title: Content Vertical

deliver_at.description: Delivery date. Accepts: ISO 8601 date (`YYYY-MM-DD`), `today`, `asap` (alias for today), `tomorrow`, or `N-days-from-now` (e.g. `5-days-from-now`). A weekend or printer holiday moves to the next print date (see `move_to_next_print_date`). Must be at most 90 days in the future. Omitting this field schedules the card for the next available business day.
deliver_at.title: Deliver At

move_to_next_print_date.description: Set to `false` to get 422 `invalid-delivery-date` instead of moving a weekend or printer-holiday `deliver_at`. The response's `deliver_at` shows the date actually scheduled.
move_to_next_print_date.title: Move To Next Print Date

font.description: Optional; defaults to architects_daughter at the middle allowed size. Color defaults to black when omitted.

simulate.description: Sandbox only. Instead of creating the card, force a simulated error so API clients can test their error handling. `insufficient_funds` returns HTTP 402 with the normal insufficient-funds body. Ignored with a live key.
simulate.title: Simulate

EchtpostCreateCardFromTemplateConfig.description: Create a card from a template

use_default_vertical_text.description: Print the EchtPost default vertical text instead of inheriting the template text. Overrides Content Vertical when enabled.
use_default_vertical_text.title: Use Default Vertical Text

content_vertical.description: Vertical text on the back side for this card. Omit it or pass null to use the template's vertical text; an empty string prints the EchtPost default. A non-empty value returns 422 `not_available_for_motive` when the template's motive has `vertical_text_available: false`. A custom value requires the booked vertical text upgrade for the account, otherwise 422 `feature-not-available`. The template's vertical text follows the same rule; pass an empty string to print the EchtPost default instead.
content_vertical.title: Content Vertical

deliver_at.description: Delivery date. Accepts: ISO 8601 date (`YYYY-MM-DD`), `today`, `asap` (alias for today), `tomorrow`, or `N-days-from-now` (e.g. `5-days-from-now`). A weekend or printer holiday moves to the next print date (see `move_to_next_print_date`). Must be at most 90 days in the future. Omitting this field schedules the card for the next available business day.
deliver_at.title: Deliver At

move_to_next_print_date.description: Set to `false` to get 422 `invalid-delivery-date` instead of moving a weekend or printer-holiday `deliver_at`. The response's `deliver_at` shows the date actually scheduled.
move_to_next_print_date.title: Move To Next Print Date

simulate.description: Sandbox only. Instead of creating the card, force a simulated error so API clients can test their error handling. `insufficient_funds` returns HTTP 402 with the normal insufficient-funds body. Ignored with a live key.
simulate.title: Simulate
